Name: Vanilla Non-Marriageable NPCs Portraits
Author: Acc9000
Description:
The portraits can be obtained from the catalogue bought at Robin.

Now you can:

- finally put a portrait of your beloved Sandy, Caroline, Robin, Marlon, Gil or maybe even Fizz on your wall
- display your favourite (or hated) characters in halls of fame (or shame)
- make a rainbow display or themed rooms
- hang pictures of your kids in their room
- make a display of creatures living in the forest in your guildhouse (should you turn your farmhouse into one)
- educate children about which creatures are dangerous and which are safe
- possibly make a target out of some for throwing things (or imagine)

Etc. Get creative!

----

This mod was made by me, Acc9000 (AcceptableFudge9000).

I used sprites from the Characters folder, apart from the beach and seasonal outfits and, of course, the standard bachelor(ette) NPCs.
Vanilla graphics by ConcernedApe

Do not modify/repost without my permission.
